mapper.select: SELECT e.ID AS id, e.NAME AS name, s.NAME AS storeName, e.INCUMBENCY_STS AS incumbencySts, e.HANDSET AS handset, e.ISSALER AS issaler, e.ISSTOREMAN AS isstoreman FROM HR_EMPLOYEE e LEFT JOIN C_STORE s ON e.C_STORE_ID = s.ID WHERE TRIM(e.NO) = TRIM(#{staffNo}) AND ROWNUM = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM C_STORE WHERE NAME = #{storeName} AND ISACTIVE = 'Y'
